description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Range 60 feet

Somewhere in the last twenty years, giving the order and it already having happened became the same event.

Up to four allies who can hear and understand you each immediately take a single action of their choice — Strike, Stride, Step, Raise a Shield, or Interact. They take these in an order you choose, before anyone else acts. An ally who has already benefited from your called command this round takes their action at a −2 circumstance penalty.
